verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is documented as an open-source commerce platform for WordPress that gives owners full control of their data, and it installs onto the user's own WordPress site. The public GitHub repository documents building it from source, so the core product can be run on infrastructure the user controls. missing for 10: an explicit first-party self-hosting/server installation guide (hosting requirements, deployment steps), independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
